title: Atlas Action
description: One thing a run DID: a source read, a model call, a tool invocation. Distinct from `next_action` on an evaluation, which is an instruction about what should happen and is written by the checker — this is a record of what happened and is written by the loop. Every field is the core's; nothing a producer writes can add an action or change one, because an action log a producer could write would be a log of what it said it did. Defining this contract does not make the loop record actions: nothing emits these yet, and a Run.v2 that carries no action log says `actions: null` with `not_recorded`, never an empty list — an empty list would state that the run did nothing.

action_id.description: Stable within a run. Derived from the run, the iteration and the action's own position, so two logs of the same run agree on which record is which.

run_id.description: The run this belongs to. Carried on the record itself so an action extracted from the document, or appended to a log that outlives it, is still attributable.

kind.description: What was done, from a closed vocabulary. A free-text kind would be a category nobody can aggregate over.

started_at.description: ISO 8601. When it began, not when it was recorded.

capability.description: For a tool call, the capability the gateway checked. Null for a kind that is not a tool call — not omitted, so absence is stated rather than inferred.

target.description: What it acted on: a tool name, a source path, a provider. Null when the kind has no single target.

input_sha256.description: Digest of the input, so a replay can be compared without the input being stored. Absence is `null` and only `null` — the pattern does not admit the empty string, because a field with two ways to say nothing has a way that reads as a value. Never a digest of the empty input standing in for "nothing was hashed".

outcome.description: `denied` is a refusal by a boundary — the gateway, the capability list — and is a normal result, not an error. `failed` is an attempt that was allowed and did not succeed.

error.description: The failure's type name, never a body. A provider can echo a request header back in an error payload, and this is written to disk.
